info.title: ExpenseWise API
info.description: The API behind the ExpenseWise web and iOS apps. Money is always integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase Auth access token for a signed-in user.

assuranceLevel.description: aal2 means this session passed multi-factor authentication.

keyHint.description: The last four characters of the stored key.

authScheme.description: How the provider accepted the key: as an API key header or a bearer token.

apiKey.description: The key from the provider. It is checked with the provider, then stored encrypted and never returned.

reason.description: Why the key could not be used, when valid is false.

detail.description: What the provider answered, when it answered. Never the key.

current.description: Whether this is the sign-in making the request.

accessToken.description: An access token for the other sign-in, from signing in with it moments ago. With the request's own token it proves the caller controls both. Used once, never stored.

canSwitch.description: Whether the caller may switch features.

source.description: Where `enabled` comes from: the default (off), the organization's switch, or the server's override, which beats the switch until it is removed.

switchedAt.description: When the organization last switched it, if it has.

canEdit.description: Only the owner changes the details.

homeCurrency.description: ISO 4217. Reports opened from now on are in it; reports already opened keep theirs, and no amount is converted.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone. With organization settings on, it says when the organization’s day ends: when trips and local expenses join a report, and which day is day 28.

size.description: How many people it has, in bands.

name.description: The organization’s name. It can’t be blank.

homeCurrency.description: An ISO 4217 code ExpenseWise supports. It can’t be blank.

locale.description: A BCP 47 language tag; blank clears it.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone; blank clears it.

address.description: The postal address, lines and all; blank clears it.

industry.description: What it does; blank clears it.

size.description: One of just_me, 2_10, 11_50, 51_200, 201_1000, over_1000; blank clears it.

minutes.description: How many minutes apart two receipts at one place can be and still be one purchase. 0 is the same minute only.

canEdit.description: Only the owner sets it, for everyone.

token.description: Uploads one file to this path, once.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

status.description: processing while it is read; extracted (shown as Ready) when both compared models read it with confidence and agree, or when a member confirmed or corrected a reading (ADR-0021); needs_review otherwise, including when only the fallback model read it; failed when no model could read it. Under the organization’s AI model settings, extracted rests on one confident reading by the first model that could read it, and needs_review with no reading means every model was off (ADR-0033).

assumed.description: True for a tax or tip the receipt does not print, taken as zero rather than read. Never set when the line is printed but unreadable, or when the printed figures leave an amount unaccounted for.

id.description: The receiptId from the upload ticket.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

agreed.description: Of those, how many they read alike.

role.description: compared: one of the models the tier decision weighs. fallback: read only because no compared model could (ADR-0020). Under the organization’s AI model settings (FR-INT-16): primary, the model chosen to read every receipt; backup, read only because the models before it could not (ADR-0033).

readingAvailable.description: Whether this server can hand receipts to the workflow runner for reading.

receipts.description: How many of the receipts shown it is over: those read.

p95Ms.description: The 95th-percentile time from filing to the first settled reading, in whole milliseconds, by nearest rank: one of the times measured. Null with none read.

CaptureTime.description: Capture to Ready over the receipts shown (receipts.capture-time, NFR-PERF-01). A receipt counts once its first reading settles, Ready, needing a look or not read; the time a person then takes to confirm it is not counted. Left out while the feature is off.

code.description: failed: no model could read it. duplicate: it looks like the same purchase as an earlier receipt (FR-INT-18). fallback: only the fallback model read it. differ: the compared models read the filing fields differently. checks: its sums or date fail a check, or it is a purchase summary (FR-INT-04). unsure: a model was not confident, or one could not read it. not_read: every AI model was off, so it was filed for the person to fill in (FR-INT-16).

fields.description: differ: the filing fields read differently.

checks.description: checks: the checks the readings fail.

error.description: failed: why the first compared model could not read it, such as no_key.

by.description: fallback: the model that read it.

kind.description: exact: the same merchant, day, time and total, and no other place. possible: the same purchase perhaps amended, such as a tip added, or matched on the total alone where the receipts don’t both say when and where (FR-INT-18, ADR-0031).

duplicateOf.description: duplicate: the earlier receipt it looks like.

code.description: overdue: past day 28 and nothing ready. closing_soon: in its last week, something still needing review, so reimbursement may wait. ready_to_close: nothing left to do.

status.description: open: trips and local expenses join it. closed: done, by the person or on day 28, and reopenable until submitted. Submitting is the person’s own act (FR-EXP-12).

currency.description: What it is reimbursed in: the organization’s home currency.

closesAt.description: When an open report closes itself: day 28, later if reopened.

needsAttention.description: Trips with an expense still being read or needing review, and local expenses needing review or a justification. It can’t close while any are left.

warning.description: Open, in its last week, and something still needs review.

overdue.description: Open past its day 28, with nothing on it ready to close.

totals.description: One total per currency, never converted; possible duplicates are left out (until #62).

code.description: justification: a local expense says nothing yet of why (FR-EXP-14).

imageUrl.description: A short-lived link to the original file (5 minutes).

differences.description: Filing fields the two models read differently.

duplicates.description: Receipts that look like the same purchase as this one: same member, currency and total, dates a day apart at most, and a similar merchant (FR-INT-18).

role.description: compared: one of the models the tier decision weighs. fallback: read only because no compared model could (ADR-0020). Under the organization’s AI model settings (FR-INT-16): primary, the model chosen to read every receipt; backup, read only because the models before it could not (ADR-0033).

address.description: The merchant’s address as printed. Neither decides Ready.

Text only: the models say what the line says, not where on the image it is. Null for a reading made without them; left out altogether while the feature is off.

model.description: Whose reading was confirmed or corrected.

values.description: What the receipt is filed with.

read.description: What the model read; null when it read nothing.

ReceiptConfirmation.description: Set when a member confirmed this reading; the merchant, date and total above are then the confirmed values.

kind.description: exact: the same merchant, day, time and total, and no other place. possible: the same purchase perhaps amended, such as a tip added, or matched on the total alone where the receipts don’t both say when and where (FR-INT-18, ADR-0031).

held.description: Whether this receipt is the later copy, which needs a look until the person decides and is left out of totals meanwhile.

time.description: When it was bought, HH:MM local time.

DuplicateSide.description: One receipt of a possible duplicate pair, with the expense it proves.

model.description: The reading to confirm, by model, from the receipt’s latest readings. Omitted only for a receipt nothing read, because every AI model was off: every field is then entered in corrections.

merchant.description: The merchant, as it should be filed.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code. Amounts keep their printed value.

total.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

taxTotal.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

tip.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

corrections.description: Only the fields the person changed. Omit to confirm as read.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code. Amounts keep their printed value.

total.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

taxTotal.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

tip.description: A plain decimal in the receipt’s currency.

corrections.description: The fields the person corrected, usually one.

kept.description: The receipt that remains; for kept_both, the one in the path.

taken.description: merged: the fields the primary took from the receipt merged into it.

oneOf.description: Different purchases: both stay, and the pair is never flagged again.

keep.description: The receipt to keep, one of the two.

oneOf.description: The other receipt is deleted with its file, readings and expense. Its audit trail stays, saying what it was.

primary.description: The receipt to keep, one of the two.

fields.description: Fields the primary takes from the other even though it has them. It takes every field it lacks anyway. amount brings its currency.

oneOf.description: The primary’s expense takes the other’s missing and chosen fields, then the other is deleted as delete deletes it.

status.description: processing while its receipt is read; ready when its receipt is Ready and merchant, date, currency and amount are filled in; needs_review otherwise. Submitted, approved and settled follow its report; approved is locked (FR-EXP-03).

owner.description: The member whose expense it is.

trip.description: The trip it is filed to (FR-EXP-04), or null for none.

tripFiledBy.description: date: it files to the trip its date falls in, and moves when the dates do. person: a person chose its trip, or chose none, and filing by date leaves it there (ADR-0023).

matchesReceipt.description: Whether merchant, date, currency and amount match what its receipt shows. Null without a receipt.

local.description: On no trip, with a date: a local expense, which needs a justification before its report can close (FR-EXP-14).

justification.description: Why a local expense was for business.

reportId.description: The report it is on: its trip’s, or its own when local (FR-EXP-05).

state.description: confirmed: a person chose them. suggested: worked out from what it shows, until a person confirms it. missing: neither, so the expense says it needs them.

basis.description: For a suggestion: history, what its owner last chose for the same merchant; keywords, what its merchant or reading names. Rules, never a model (ADR-0036).

editable.description: Whether it can be edited now: while it needs review or is Ready.

editedAt.description: When a person last edited it. A reading never overwrites an edit.

confirmedBy.description: Who confirmed the receipt’s reading, if anyone.

differences.description: Where the expense differs from its receipt.

detailDifferences.description: Where its time or place differs from the receipt’s. Shown, never a reason to reject.

time.description: When it was bought, HH:MM local time (FR-INT-17).

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone of that time: worked out from the place, or set by a person.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 code. The amount keeps its written value.

amount.description: A plain decimal in the expense’s currency.

time.description: When it was bought, HH:MM local time; blank clears it.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone. Blank, it is worked out from the place; left out, it is worked out again when the place changes.

tripId.description: The trip to put it on, or null for no trip.

byDate.description: File it to the trip its date falls in again.

days.description: Days it covers, both ends included.

owner.description: The member whose trip it is.

readyCount.description: Expenses that are Ready, or further along: submitted or later.

totals.description: What its expenses add up to, one total per currency, never converted. Expenses with no amount yet count in none.

reportId.description: The report it is on (FR-EXP-05), or null before it joins one.

expenses.description: In date order; those with no date yet last.

purpose.description: Why you went. Up to 500 characters.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last day, included. A trip is at most 366 days.

perUnit.description: Currency units a mile, as a plain decimal: 72.5 cents is "0.725".

effectiveFrom.description: The day the rate took effect.

source.description: Where it came from: irs-business is the IRS standard rate for business use.

destination.description: Where you drove to. Up to 200 characters.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for older events; null on the last page.

sequence.description: Its place in the organization’s chain, from 1, with no gaps.

payload.description: What changed, as stored and hashed. It never holds a key or a token.

hash.description: SHA-256 of this event and the hash before it.

get.summary: Liveness check
get.description: Returns 200 while the API can serve requests. Does not touch the database.

get.summary: Readiness check
get.description: Connects to the database the way tenant requests do and checks what tenant isolation depends on: the runtime role, verified TLS and enforced row-level security. Results are cached for a few seconds. Details are fixed messages, never raw errors.

503.description: Not ready; at least one check failed.

get.description: Returns the identity proven by the access token. Organization memberships join this response in Phase 1.

401.description: No token, or the token is invalid or expired.

503.description: Sign-in is not configured on this server.

post.summary: The caller's organization, created on first sign-in
post.description: Returns the organization the signed-in user belongs to. On first sign-in it creates a one-person organization with the user as owner. Safe to call on every sign-in.

422.description: The account has no email address.

503.description: Sign-in or the database is not configured on this server.

get.summary: The ways the caller signs in
get.description: Every sign-in (email) that reaches the same person in this organization. Each one sees the same receipts, expenses and settings.

post.summary: Add another sign-in for the same person
post.description: Links a second sign-in, such as a work email, to the caller. The body carries an access token for that sign-in, so the caller proves control of both. If the other sign-in had created its own organization and left it empty, it moves; otherwise nothing changes.

201.description: The sign-in now reaches the caller.
